articles.title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
articles.snippet: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.

articles.title: Should Government Officials Be Banned From Prediction Markets? House Oversight Says Maybe
articles.snippet: A House Oversight staff memorandum, citing suspicious trades by officials, military personnel and clearance holders, recommends Congress weigh new limits on federal personnel betting on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket.

articles.title: Who Is Colette Kress, Jensen Huang’s Successor as Nvidia CEO?
articles.snippet: Nvidia’s longtime finance chief inherits its first leadership transition in 33 years, bringing decades of technology experience and Wall Street credibility to a company facing a very public leadership test.

articles.title: Illinois Crypto Tax Draws Unlikely Alliance of DOJ, Banks and DeFi
articles.snippet: The DOJ, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, SIFMA and a crypto coalition led by a16z, Paradigm and Uniswap filed briefs backing a lawsuit to strike down the state’s 0.2% levy on digital asset transactions.
